thread:
rina_s: Heads-up — RegionalBank POC went well. They want: 1) streaming token-by-token for a live UX, 2) function/tool calling to fetch KYC/enrichment, 3) strict JSON schema for downstream ledger ingestion, and 4) clear pricing comparison (hosted streaming vs reserved). Need a short presales checklist and example SDKs we can show in the demo tomorrow.

chuck: cool. Quick checklist: environment & auth, sample schema, function stubs, perf targets, security answers. Perf they care about: p95 < 120ms for 32-token replies, embedding batch QPS ~150, and steady-state memory footprint on our side for 20 concurrent streams.

evan_m: For the live demo use case, prefer python streaming snippet + a small golang consumer for their infra team. Python example (stream + tool call):
```py
# python pseudo-example
resp = client.responses.stream(
  model='redwood-neo-1',
  input='Get customer enrichment for acct 1234',
  stream=True,
  tool_calling=True,
  output_format={'type':'json_schema','schema':{'customer_id':'string','status':'string'}}
)
for chunk in resp:
  if chunk.type == 'tool_call':
    call_tool('kyc_lookup', chunk.args)
  else:
    print(chunk.delta)
```

lisa_t: note on schema: they insisted on nested transactions array and iso timestamps. Recommend we give them a strict schema and a small validator helper in the runbook. Also mention how function outputs map back into the response (tool_call results -> returned JSON field).

chuck: security Qs we should pre-answer: data residency (EU), SSO options, audit log retention windows, KMS, and customer-data ephemeral caching. Short answers: Hosted supports EU regions; Dedicated & Private can do SAML SSO + customer KMS; KV cache TTL configurable and can be disabled; audit logs exported to their SIEM via syslog/S3. I'll draft bullet answers.

evan_m: Pricing note — hosted streaming pricing: input tokens + output tokens per 1k; streaming itself doesn't have a separate surcharge. For reserved (Dedicated) we'll give a flat monthly GPU pool + per-token overage. For a quick comparison table in the demo, show unit cost at 150 QPS vs reserved lease cost for their 50% percentile traffic.

lisa_t: POC blockers flagged by their infra: firewall egress rules, long-lived websocket connections for streaming, and TLS mutual auth for tool callbacks. We should provide a network guide + sample nginx ingress config.

qa-bot: test-plan created: smoke (streaming responses), function-call success/failure paths, schema validation, fallback routing when latency > threshold, and cost simulation for token burn. Plan id: POC-2026-04-12.

rina_s: timeline: 1) send short runbook + two SDK snippets (py/go) within 2hrs, 2) reply to security questionnaire by EOD with bullets, 3) include a small perf guidance doc (p95 targets + recommended Dedicated sizing) before the demo. Who owns the runbook?

chuck: I'll own the runbook + nginx sample. evan_m you can produce the go consumer example and the pricing sketch. lisa_t please populate the security bullets. I'll stitch them together and post the doc here.

rina_s: perfect — please ping me when ready. small ask for the SDK examples: include an example of validating output JSON against the schema and handling partial-stream failures (e.g., model times out and we fallback to cached prefix).

evan_m: noted. For partial-stream failures suggest this pattern: keep a checkpointed buffer, if stream stalls for >250ms attempt fast fallback model, emit a partial JSON with a warning field, and emit metrics to Console for automated rollback. We'll add pseudo-code.

lisa_t: added firewall & mTLS notes to security bullets. also included recommended retention windows for audit logs (90/365 days options).

chuck: draft runbook uploaded to staging storage: https://rwd-internal/pocexports/regionalbank/runbook-v1, demo deck link in the doc.

rina_s: thanks team — I'll consolidate and send to the customer's eng lead. good work :rocket:
